tests.summary: All contract tests passed (94.07% coverage); no code changes made — only a forensics report doc was added

commands.stdout: No test files affected by the changed files.

operator_result.summary: The 90s dispatch delay for CLI-created probe task task_e5b3dc5bf5ba446bbfe3b0704b153ec7 was caused by a fleet publication window (workers restarting after 898f050 landed), not a dispatch evaluation code defect.

task_shape_diff_cli_vs_fleet.detail: _normalize_task_execution_contract runs unconditionally in create_task() for ALL paths including CLI. For the mac project (which has a registered repository), CLI-created tasks receive quality=strong, source=registered_project, acc_metadata stamped, and origin.type=direct_task — identical fields to groomer and workflow-spawned tasks.

dispatch_eligibility_gates.detail: The probe task had required_capabilities=[], no_dispatch=absent, project not paused, and execution_contract.quality=strong. No dispatch gate in _task_matches_worker_claim_policy() or _agent_availability_for_task() would have rejected it. The dispatch SQL WHERE clause (state=OPEN, owner_agent_id IS NULL, lease_id IS NULL) does not filter on acc_metadata or execution_contract.quality.

acc_metadata_absent_at_creation.detail: acc_metadata IS absent in the raw CLI payload, but _normalize_task_execution_contract stamps it automatically when it resolves the registered project repository (Branch 3, services.py:3640). The normalized task stored in the DB has acc_metadata. This is not a dispatch gate.

normalize_not_running_on_cli_path.detail: _normalize_task_execution_contract is called at services.py:3332 inside create_task(), which is the single canonical path used by CLI, groomer, workflow child addition, and all other callers. No bypass exists.

worker_routing_task_skipped_logs.detail: worker.routing.task_skipped is emitted at level=debug inside _claim_next_for_agent_impl() (the worker-pull path). If workers were offline/restarting during the 90s window, they would not have called claim-next at all, producing zero skip logs. Absence of skip logs means the task was never evaluated, NOT that evaluation was suppressed.

correlation_with_898f050_deployment.detail: 898f050 is the base SHA of this worktree and landed shortly before the probe task was claimed. MAC fleet workers restart when a REPO_UPDATE_TOPIC AgentBus stream is processed (_handle_repo_update_stream -> restart_requested=True -> run_forever exits -> process-manager restarts). During restart, workers are OFFLINE and excluded from _available_agents(). If all fleet workers were mid-restart simultaneously, no agent was available to claim the task from either the worker-pull (claim-next) or hub-push (dispatch_once/tick) paths. 90s is consistent with a fleet-wide rolling restart including runtime-dep reconcile on startup.

separate_dispatch_code_defect.detail: No dispatch evaluation code defect separate from the silent-death bug was identified. The delay was purely operational: workers offline during fleet publication window. No follow-up task is warranted for a dispatch code fix.
